Set under the microscope.

Regular pavé is set by eye or with a loupe. Micro pavé is set under a stereo microscope, usually at 10 to 40 times, so the setter can work in fractions of a millimetre.

Gold guide · 14K or 18K?

14 karat is 58.5% gold: harder, more scratch resistant, a lighter colour and the better choice for very fine claws. 18 karat is 75% gold: a richer colour and heavier feel, softer, so it develops a gentle patina. Every VRIAH ring comes in both, in yellow, white or rose.
